title: Chill, Relax & Craft
description: A relaxing vanilla+ Modpack focused on Environment and Ambiance
body:
A cozy vanilla+ modpack focused on environment and ambiance.
In this modpack, you can:
- Chill on a sky island
- Explore a vast world
- Go mining in some pretty spooky caves
- Fight for your life in the Nether
- Live in the End
- Sit around a campfire
- Or just take your time and relax (the in-game time is linked to your system time)

You can customize the modpack however you like.

I’m not sure how well this modpack runs on a server.

This is the first modpack I’ve released. I recommend playing it with 8GB of RAM. If you encounter any bugs, please report them to me.
